title.value: Individual Brain Charting dataset: Data Descriptor extension, third release for movie watching and retinotopy data
title.justification: The title is clearly stated in the paper.
title.quote: Individual Brain Charting dataset: Data Descriptor extension, third release for movie watching and retinotopy data

analysis.description: The paper presents an extension of the Individual Brain Charting dataset, focusing on the inclusion of movie watching and retinotopy tasks. It offers a comprehensive dataset aimed at understanding cognitive mapping and brain function using fMRI data.

type.justification: The paper describes data collection, experimentation, and analysis methods, which are characteristic of empirical studies.
type.quote: To avoid ambiguity with MRI-related terms, definitions follow the Brain-Imaging-Data-Structure (BIDS) Specification version 1.8.0.

name.justification: The study is centered around brain imaging techniques and fMRI data analysis.
name.quote: The Individual Brain Charting (IBC) is a multi-task functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging dataset acquired at high spatial-resolution and dedicated to the cognitive mapping of the human brain.

name.justification: The research aims to map cognitive functions through brain imaging.
name.quote: IBC is thus intended to serve as a source of functional correlates of various cognitive conditions, in order to support research in human neuroscience.

name.justification: The dataset aims to cover a broad range of psychological domains.
name.quote: Mapping cognition across the whole human brain requires the multi-dimensional analysis of the correlates of behavior corresponding to a wide range of psychological domains.

name.justification: FastSRM is highlighted as a model used for data-driven solutions in the study.
name.quote: We rely on the Fast Shared Response Model (FastSRM) to provide a data-driven solution for modelling naturalistic stimuli, typically containing many features.

is_contributed.justification: The model is used in the study but not contributed as a new development.
is_contributed.quote: We rely on the Fast Shared Response Model (FastSRM) to provide a data-driven solution.

is_executed.justification: The execution platform for FastSRM is not specified in the paper.

is_compared.justification: The paper does not include a numerical comparison with other models.

referenced_paper_title.value: Fastsrm: A fast, memory efficient and identifiable implementation of the shared response model
referenced_paper_title.justification: The FastSRM is referenced to this paper within the study as the source for the model.
referenced_paper_title.quote: To this end, we showcase how to extract networks linked to mental functions elicited by these tasks, using the Fast Shared Response Model (FastSRM), as described in Richard&Thirion.

name.justification: The IBC dataset is the primary focus of the paper, representing their main data contribution.
name.quote: The Individual Brain Charting (IBC) is a multi-task functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging dataset acquired at high spatial-resolution and dedicated to the cognitive mapping of the human brain.

referenced_paper_title.value: Individual Brain Charting, a high-resolution fMRI dataset for cognitive mapping
referenced_paper_title.justification: Previous work contributing the initial version of this dataset is cited to contextualize this extension.
referenced_paper_title.quote: The first and second releases of the IBC dataset encompass a broad range of cognitive domains, with an emphasis of the second release on higher-order cognition.

name.justification: Mentioned as an initiative inspired by naturalistic stimuli studies in the field.
name.quote: The study of real-life, dynamic and multimodal sensory stimuli–a.k.a. naturalistic stimuli–was introduced in parallel in the field of cognitive neuroimaging by two seminal papers, and led to initiatives such as the studyforrest dataset.

referenced_paper_title.value: A high-resolution 7-Tesla fMRI dataset from complex natural stimulation with an audio movie
referenced_paper_title.justification: This paper is referenced as part of the background context for naturalistic stimuli research.
referenced_paper_title.quote: They are thought to reduce biases inherent to the choice of artificial behavioral settings, and importantly, a priori designed contrasts, led to initiatives such as the studyforrest dataset.

name.justification: Freesurfer is mentioned as a library used for surface extraction and sampling of functional activation.
name.quote: The T1-weighted MPRAGE volume and the aligned GE-EPI volumes were then given as input to FreeSurfer v6.0.0, in order to extract the surface meshes of the tissue interfaces and a sampling of the functional activation on these meshes.
